3mb5i3s NASA EXTERIOR · PBR
81gedpq Educational interiors specific to each assembly. The geometry, dimensions and wiring are not validated flight CAD.
ae40g8p Lunar Orbiter I · flight configuration with the thermal blanket installed and the camera door open. Panels and antennas deployed. Fine geometry and interiors without public drawings are educational reconstructions.
1rknr27 Phoenix rebuilt from documentation of its instruments and NASA/JPL photographs. Fine details without public drawings are approximate.
97onpc3 Exterior rebuilt from NASA photographs and documentation. Undocumented details are visual approximations.
t1jlolf Historic exterior from NASA 3D Resources.
9bnh8co The cabin belonged to the ascent stage; only the descent stage stayed on the Moon.
tm3qo2k Current orbital location not confirmed.
e3sstsj Interior open · Press a label to go on to the component.
x5hhnfa Deep Space 2 · capsule closed in the overview. Lid, antenna and finishes rebuilt from NASA/JPL photographs; see the reference images on the mission page. The interior and its divisions are educational.
js2ucoh Select a part to lift it. Back puts it in place again; the probe stays transparent as a reference.
750t4gj Closed capsule · select a system to see inside it.
ykit3lq InSight · assemblies backed by NASA/JPL and the SEIS team. The views keep the lander as context; the exploded view is educational. The SEIS-AC card uses its published photograph. No circuit-board traces are invented without documentation.
zwmwrcx InSight · exterior and colors from the NASA 3D resource. Inspection setup before deployment: SEIS, WTS and HP³ on the deck; arm raised. The shape of small details is not certified flight CAD.
ld0adg2 Select a system. The spacecraft stays as a reference during the inspection.
ojorirc Phoenix · each instrument keeps its position on the lander. Parts lift when you select them and the harnesses follow their connectors. See the sources: board layouts and other details without drawings are educational.
cy3m3zb Phoenix · arm extended with aluminum links and titanium fittings; TEGA with inlets on two faces. Deck and instruments based on NASA/JPL and PDS. Representative pose; internal details without public drawings are marked as educational.
ss5fp4x Tap a part to lift it. The spacecraft stays transparent as a reference; «Back» brings the assembly together.
iljhilp Viking · cutaways based on NASA RP-1027. Boards, traces, windings and internal ducts without complete drawings are educational; check the evidence for each component.
0fdvkb9 Viking · surface configuration rebuilt from NASA figures 21, 23, 72 and 93. Tanks and engines outside the body; antennas on their mounts. Antenna and sampler orientation are representative, not the state on a specific sol.
8azbzqt The system separates and the spacecraft stays as a reference. «Reassemble» brings its parts back together.
30s49n0 Surveyor III · step-by-step exploded view based on JPL TR 32-1177 and NASA SP-184. Each part shows its reference. Traces, optical prescriptions and internal details without public drawings are marked as educational.
k49kt8p Surveyor III · surface configuration before Apollo 12. Includes the auxiliary battery, Canopus sensor, three verniers and their six tanks. The central retro-rocket, already separated, is studied in the flight propulsion view.

ty5hwax The 3D graphics could not start
ktsmpk3 The browser allowed WebGL 1 but not WebGL 2, which this viewer needs. The error happens before the model is downloaded.
6b6e8l9 Try NEPTUNI in a separate tab. If it happens there too, check your browser's graphics acceleration. The mission page and the sources are still available.
l0uplx3 The 3D file could not be accessed
6gxqzug Check that you opened NEPTUNI with the account that has access. Don't change the site's permissions to fix a graphics error.
155qjgo The model could not be downloaded
x50nqae The download does not contain a complete model
cxrdqo3 The response is not a valid, complete GLB file. It could be an error page or an incomplete download.
0jcuaj8 Loading took too long
5mr7054 Downloading or preparing the model did not finish in the time available.
jeh4vr5 Check your connection and try loading it again.

j2gl2g5 The browser started the graphics but failed to compile one of the model's materials.
olwlubg This is a rendering error, not an access denial. You can check the file and retry the viewer.
